SliderTickBuilder.buildBlock(_:_:_:_:_:_:_:_:_:_:) | static func buildBlock<C0, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C9>(_ c0: C0, _ c1: C1, _ c2: C2, _ c3: C3, _ c4: C4, _ c5: C5, _ c6: C6, _ c7: C7, _ c8: C8, _ c9: C9) -> TupleSliderTickContent<V, (C0, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C9)> where V == C0.Value, C0 : SliderTickContent, C1 : SliderTickContent, C2 : SliderTickContent, C3 : SliderTickContent, C4 : SliderTickContent, C5 : SliderTickContent, C6 : SliderTickContent, C7 : SliderTickContent, C8 : SliderTickContent, C9 : SliderTickContent, C0.Value == C1.Value, C1.Value == C2.Value, C2.Value == C3.Value, C3.Value == C4.Value, C4.Value == C5.Value, C5.Value == C6.Value, C6.Value == C7.Value, C7.Value == C8.Value, C8.Value == C9.Value
SliderTickBuilder.buildEither(first:) | static func buildEither<T, F>(first: T) -> _ConditionalSliderTickContent<T, F> where V == T.Value, T : SliderTickContent, F : SliderTickContent, T.Value == F.Value
SliderTickBuilder.buildEither(second:) | static func buildEither<T, F>(second: F) -> _ConditionalSliderTickContent<T, F> where V == T.Value, T : SliderTickContent, F : SliderTickContent, T.Value == F.Value
SliderTickBuilder.buildExpression(_:) | static func buildExpression<C>(_ content: C) -> C where V == C.Value, C : SliderTickContent
SliderTickBuilder.buildIf(_:) | static func buildIf<C>(_ content: C?) -> C? where V == C.Value, C : SliderTickContent
SliderTickContent | protocol SliderTickContent<Value>
SliderTickContent.Body | associatedtype Body : RandomAccessCollection where Self.Body.Element == SliderTick<Self.Value>
SliderTickContent.Value | associatedtype Value : BinaryFloatingPoint
SliderTickContent.body | var body: Self.Body { get }
SliderTickContentForEach | struct SliderTickContentForEach<Data, ID, Content> where Data : RandomAccessCollection, ID : Hashable, Content : SliderTickContent
SliderTickContentForEach.Body | typealias Body = [SliderTick<Content.Value>]
SliderTickContentForEach.Value | typealias Value = Content.Value
SliderTickContentForEach.body | let body: [SliderTick<Content.Value>]
SliderTickContentForEach.init(_:content:) | init<V>(_ data: Data, @SliderTickBuilder<V> content: @escaping (Data.Element) -> Content) where ID == V.ID, V : Identifiable, V == Data.Element, Data.Element == Content.Value
SliderTickContentForEach.init(_:content:) | init<V>(_ data: Range<Int>, @SliderTickBuilder<V> content: @escaping (Range<Int>.Element) -> Content) where Data == Range<Int>, ID == Int, V == Content.Value
SliderTickContentForEach.init(_:id:content:) | init<V>(_ data: Data, id: KeyPath<Data.Element, ID>, @SliderTickBuilder<V> content: @escaping (Data.Element) -> Content) where V == Data.Element, Data.Element == Content.Value

TrackConfiguration | struct TrackConfiguration
TrackConfiguration.Background | enum Background
TrackConfiguration.Background.glyph(_:) | static func glyph(_ glyph: Character) -> TrackConfiguration.Background
TrackConfiguration.Background.pattern(_:) | case pattern(String)
TrackConfiguration.Background.solid | case solid
TrackConfiguration.background | var background: TrackConfiguration.Background
TrackConfiguration.backgroundColor | var backgroundColor: Color?
TrackConfiguration.backgroundGradient | var backgroundGradient: Gradient?
TrackConfiguration.bar | static let bar: TrackConfiguration
TrackConfiguration.block | static let block: TrackConfiguration
TrackConfiguration.blockFine | static let blockFine: TrackConfiguration
TrackConfiguration.braille | static let braille: TrackConfiguration
TrackConfiguration.fill | var fill: String
TrackConfiguration.fillGradient | var fillGradient: Gradient?
TrackConfiguration.init(fill:leadingEdge:background:fillGradient:backgroundColor:backgroundGradient:) | init(fill: String, leadingEdge: [Character]? = nil, background: TrackConfiguration.Background, fillGradient: Gradient? = nil, backgroundColor: Color? = nil, backgroundGradient: Gradient? = nil)
TrackConfiguration.init(fullGlyph:leadingEdge:background:fillGradient:backgroundColor:backgroundGradient:) | init(fullGlyph: Character, leadingEdge: [Character]? = nil, background: TrackConfiguration.Background, fillGradient: Gradient? = nil, backgroundColor: Color? = nil, backgroundGradient: Gradient? = nil)
TrackConfiguration.leadingEdge | var leadingEdge: [Character]?
TrackConfiguration.shade | static let shade: TrackConfiguration
TrackConfiguration.shadeRamp(gradient:) | static func shadeRamp(gradient: Gradient? = nil) -> TrackConfiguration

TrackGradientScaling.region | case region
TrackGradientScaling.track | case track
TrackStyle | enum TrackStyle
TrackStyle.bar | case bar
TrackStyle.block | case block

TrackStyle.braille | case braille
TrackStyle.custom(_:) | case custom(TrackConfiguration)
TrackStyle.dot | case dot
TrackStyle.knob | case knob
TrackStyle.marker | case marker
TrackStyle.shade | case shade

TrackStyle.threeSegment(leading:middle:trailing:backgroundPattern:coloring:) | case threeSegment(leading: String, middle: String, trailing: String, backgroundPattern: String = " ", coloring: SegmentColoring = .automatic)
TupleSliderTickContent | @frozen struct TupleSliderTickContent<V, T> where V : BinaryFloatingPoint
TupleSliderTickContent.Body | typealias Body = [SliderTick<V>]
TupleSliderTickContent.TicksCollection | typealias TicksCollection = [SliderTick<V>]
TupleSliderTickContent.Value | typealias Value = V
TupleSliderTickContent.body | let body: [SliderTick<V>]
TupleSliderTickContent.value | var value: T

View.indeterminateStyle(_:) | nonisolated func indeterminateStyle(_ style: IndeterminateStyle) -> some View
View.progressViewStyle(_:) | nonisolated func progressViewStyle<S>(_ style: S) -> some View where S : ProgressViewStyle
View.sliderShowsValue(_:) | nonisolated func sliderShowsValue(_ shows: Bool) -> some View
View.sliderThumbVisibility(_:) | nonisolated func sliderThumbVisibility(_ visibility: Visibility) -> some View
View.stepperValueWidth(_:) | nonisolated func stepperValueWidth(_ width: Int?) -> some View
View.trackGradientScaling(_:) | nonisolated func trackGradientScaling(_ scaling: TrackGradientScaling) -> some View
View.trackGradientScaling(fill:background:) | nonisolated func trackGradientScaling(fill: TrackGradientScaling, background: TrackGradientScaling) -> some View
_ConditionalSliderTickContent | enum _ConditionalSliderTickContent<TrueContent, FalseContent> where TrueContent : SliderTickContent, FalseContent : SliderTickContent, TrueContent.Value == FalseContent.Value
_ConditionalSliderTickContent.Body | typealias Body = [SliderTick<TrueContent.Value>]
_ConditionalSliderTickContent.Value | typealias Value = TrueContent.Value
_ConditionalSliderTickContent.body | var body: [SliderTick<TrueContent.Value>] { get }
_ConditionalSliderTickContent.falseContent(_:) | case falseContent(FalseContent)
_ConditionalSliderTickContent.trueContent(_:) | case trueContent(TrueContent)
